releases.notes:

#  Fixes
* Fix fluids filling input tanks incorrectly filling other input fluid tanks when they shouldn't (e.g. in the Fluid Mixer).

releases.notes:
This is the first Alpha for 0.5. This release contains minor rebalancing but is mostly under-the-hood optimizations. With recipe changes in 1.20.2, it wasn't feasible to backport this to 1.20.1, sorry! Please backup your worlds and report any bugs you find.

# Changes
* Animal Fat now drops from all Sheep colours, Dolphins, Llamas, Mooshrooms, Pandas, and Polar Bears
* Rebalanced various Hydroponic Incubator recipes, mostly regarding crops
	* Most crop outputs now produce 9 items
* Further optimize recipes, with a "V2" Recipe Cache implementation, port to 1.20.2+ Recipe changes in vanilla
* Major refactoring to most Recipe JSONs
* Optimizations for the Blast Furnace (Closes #114)

releases.notes:
# Additions
* Added Slot and Tank labels: when opening the IO menu, labels now appear on Slots and Tanks with their Slot ID to make it easier to figure out which IDs in the IO menu affect which slots and tanks
* Hovering over the toggle button above the FE Bar in the Battery Box's GUI now has a tooltip describing the current mode
* Soul Torches can now be crafted with Rosin in lieu of Coal

# Changes
* Stirling Generator and Primitive Stirling Generator now use a parallel (multi-threaded) recipe query to validate recipes when ticking/burning a fuel
*  Slots validating items to be inserted for the Stirling Generator have been optimized. They now use the multi-threaded query as well.

# Fixes
* Tanks no longer have a tooltip that shows 0 FE on their screen when hovering the cursor around where one would expect a FE Bar to normally be  
* Primitive Stirling Generator now accepts all solid fuels that have Stirling recipes
* Fixed a bug that only allowed 4,000 mB of fluid to be added using buckets in the Tank tile entities that are supposed to have a capacity greater than 4,000 mB

releases.notes:
NOTE: PLEASE DELETE/RESET YOUR CONFIGURATION FILES FOR VOLUMINOUS ENERGY OR ELSE GENERATION RATES OF OIL LAKES AND OIL GEYSERS MAY NOT WORK PROPERLY. THE CHANCE VALUES STILL MEAN BIGGER = RARER BUT THE PREVIOUS DEFAULTS MAY RESULT IN FEATURES SPAWNING TOO RARELY OR TOO COMMONLY. 
 
This updated re-introduces fluid placement along with the generation of Oil features similar to what was present in 1.16.


## Changes:
* All fluids can now be placed thanks to Minecraft Forge Issue #7922 being fixed in 37.0.127 
	* Forge version 37.0.127 is now required as the minimum version of Minecraft Forge
*  Re-enabled the generation of Crude Oil Lakes and Oil Geysers
	* Crude Oil Lake generation is now split between surface and underground
		* Underground has a lower chance value, spawning more commonly (Default Chance: 15)
		* Surface has a higher chance value, spawning less frequently (to prevent cluttering of the world surface with Oil Lakes) (Default Chance: 65)
	* Oil Geysers have been re-enabled.  (Default Chance: 100)

This is why you should back up your world before updating. # Fixes: * Removed duplicate recipe for Rice grains in the Crusher that would’ve already been captured by the seed recipe * Backport fix for copying unnecessary NBT data for Rice grains and the Solarium Block

releases.notes:
A new release of Voluminous Energy featuring bug fixes and some improvements!

Improvements:
* Updated the GUI for the Primitive Stirling Generator, it should now more closely resemble other TE's GUIs
* Updated the GUI for the Primitive Blast Furnace, it should now more closely resemble other TE's GUIs
* Voluminous Energy Ores now provide experience when mined. The experience received scales with the tool's Fortune enchantment level as well!

Bugfixes:
* Electric Furnace can now be crafted
* When mined, the Electric Furnace will now drop its block item
* When mined, Galena Ore will now drop its block item
